name: vedaai-assessment-creator
description: Full-stack AI Assessment Creator for the VedaAI engineering assignment.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,worker,client -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run worker --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace server && npm run lint --workspace client
